tools.name: proofhub_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the ProofHub account the key belongs to. Start here to find project ids. GET /projects.

tools.name: proofhub_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id: name, status, dates and the people on it. GET /projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: proofhub_list_todolists
tools.description: List the to-do lists (task lists) of one project. GET /projects/{project_id}/todolists.

tools.name: proofhub_list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one to-do list with title, assignees, labels, dates and completion. GET /projects/{project_id}/todolists/{todolist_id}/tasks.

tools.name: proofhub_get_task
tools.description: Get one task with its description, dates, assignees, labels and progress. GET /projects/{project_id}/todolists/{todolist_id}/tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: proofhub_list_task_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one task. GET /projects/{project_id}/todolists/{todolist_id}/tasks/{task_id}/comments.

tools.name: proofhub_search_all_tasks
tools.description: List tasks across the whole account, filtered by project, label or completion. Paged: when the reply has more records, call again with a higher start. GET /alltodo.

tools.name: proofhub_list_topics
tools.description: List the discussion topics of one project. GET /projects/{project_id}/topics.

tools.name: proofhub_list_labels
tools.description: List the task labels of the account. Use the ids in task filters. GET /labels.

tools.name: proofhub_list_people
tools.description: List the people (users) of the account with their roles and emails. GET /people.

tools.name: proofhub_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id. GET /people/{person_id}.

tools.name: proofhub_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged time entries across the account, paged. When the reply is full, call again with a higher start. GET /alltime.

tools.name: proofhub_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a to-do list. Writes to the account. Each call makes a new task, so do not retry blindly. POST /projects/{project_id}/todolists/{todolist_id}/tasks.

tools.name: proofhub_set_task_completed
tools.description: Mark one task completed (true) or open again (false). Setting the same value twice is harmless. PUT /projects/{project_id}/todolists/{todolist_id}/tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: proofhub_add_task_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on one task, as the key's user. Each call posts a new comment, so do not retry blindly. POST /projects/{project_id}/todolists/{todolist_id}/tasks/{task_id}/comments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: proofhub_list_task_comments, proofhub_list_people, proofhub_create_task · Private data: proofhub_search_all_tasks · Public sink: proofhub_create_task, proofhub_add_task_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: proofhub_list_task_comments, proofhub_list_people, proofhub_create_task · Private data: proofhub_search_all_tasks · Public sink: proofhub_create_task, proofhub_add_task_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
